privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: EveBash respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly and transparently. This Privacy Policy explains how EveBash collects, uses, stores, processes, shares, and protects personal information when people use our websites, mobile applications, accounts, event galleries, media-sharing features, business features, subscriptions, payment features, find You functionality, and related services. By using EveBash, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy. Where consent is required by applicable law, we will request appropriate consent before carrying out the relevant processing.

blocks.text: EveBash is operated jointly by Shwetank Chauhan and Sarthak Chauhan, co-founders, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001, India ("EveBash", "we", "us").
EveBash will become a product of Ossciv Private Limited once that company is incorporated, and we will update this policy when that happens.
This Privacy Policy applies to personal information processed through EveBash, including information relating to:
other individuals whose personal information may be processed through the Services.
Some photographs and videos uploaded by users may contain images of people who do not themselves have an EveBash account.
The treatment of such information may depend on the circumstances, the person who uploaded the content, applicable privacy law, and the EveBash feature being used.
The information EveBash processes depends on how you use the Services. We may process the following categories of information.
When you create or maintain an EveBash account, we may process information such as:
phone number, where provided or required;
Passwords and authentication credentials are handled through the authentication systems used by EveBash and should not be stored by EveBash in readable plaintext form.
EveBash may use authentication providers and technologies to support:
When you use a third-party login provider, EveBash may receive information permitted by that provider, such as your name, email address, account identifier, or profile information.
When an event is created or managed through EveBash, we may process information such as:
other information supplied by the event organizer.
EveBash is a digital gallery and media platform. Users may upload:
other files supported by the Services.
Media may contain information about identifiable people. EveBash processes uploaded media to provide the Services requested by users and event organizers.
Depending on the features being used, uploaded photographs and videos may undergo technical processing including:
These processes are performed to operate, secure, optimize, and deliver EveBash galleries and related features.
EveBash may provide a feature called Find You or similar functionality that helps an authorized user locate photographs in an eligible gallery in which they may appear.
When Find You is used, EveBash may process a photograph or image submitted by the user for facial matching.
detecting a face in an image;
preparing or aligning the facial region;
generating a mathematical facial representation or embedding;
comparing that representation with compatible facial representations generated from eligible gallery photographs; and
returning photographs that the system determines may contain a matching face.
A facial embedding is a mathematical representation used by the matching system. It is not intended to be used by EveBash to independently determine a person's legal identity.
Find You results are probabilistic. The system may:
fail to return a correct match; or
produce different results depending on image quality, lighting, angle, obstruction, and other technical factors.
Find You should therefore not be treated as definitive proof of identity.
Facial processing associated with Find You is intended to help authorized users locate their own or otherwise lawfully searchable photographs within eligible EveBash event galleries.
EveBash does not intend Find You to be used for general public facial identification, surveillance, stalking, law-enforcement identification, or unrelated profiling.

Find You is used only with your consent. Before your first search, EveBash asks you to confirm that you are 18 or older and to agree to the processing described in this section. We record when you agreed, the wording you agreed to and the platform you used. You can withdraw consent at any time in the app (Settings, Withdraw Find You Consent) or on the website (Settings, Withdraw Find You Consent). Find You will then ask again before any further search.
Find You may therefore be unavailable or subject to additional requirements depending on jurisdiction, age, gallery settings, event-host settings, applicable law, or other privacy considerations.

EveBash retains facial representations only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which they were created, subject to applicable legal, security, dispute-resolution, and technical requirements.
Where deletion is required or requested and applicable, EveBash will delete or de-identify eligible facial-processing data according to its applicable retention procedures.

Find You sends the submitted selfie through our backend to Modal for facial matching. Facial representations generated from gallery photographs are stored with gallery media records in Supabase. Matching compares the submitted face with representations from eligible galleries and returns possible matches.

When photos are uploaded to an EveBash gallery, EveBash automatically detects the faces in them and creates face templates, including for people who do not have an EveBash account. These templates are used only to answer Find You searches by people who can open that gallery, and they are deleted when the photo or the gallery is deleted. Anyone who appears in a gallery can ask for their images or face templates to be removed by contacting support@evebash.com.
The selfie you submit is used only for that search and is not saved. We keep only technical records of the search, such as its time, the processing cost and the size of the image.

The matching process handles the submitted selfie and its query representation during processing; this does not imply that uploaded gallery photographs, stored gallery representations, operational logs, or provider backups are immediately erased. Contact support@evebash.com to request removal of your image or facial-processing data, identifying the event or gallery where possible. Do not submit identity documents or additional selfies unless specifically requested through an appropriate verification process.

sections.title: 5. Information About People Appearing in Event Media

Some interactions may be visible to event organizers or other authorized gallery participants depending on the feature and privacy settings.

Information intentionally published through a public or discoverable profile may be visible to other users according to your applicable settings.

Some EveBash service providers may operate infrastructure in countries outside the location where a user resides. As a result, personal information may be processed or stored in other jurisdictions where permitted by applicable law.
Where cross-border processing is subject to legal requirements or restrictions, EveBash will take steps reasonably required to comply with those requirements.
EveBash uses technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, loss, misuse, or destruction.
Depending on the system involved, measures may include:
However, no online system can guarantee absolute security. Users are also responsible for protecting their account credentials and gallery-access information.
If EveBash becomes aware of a personal-data breach or security incident, we may investigate, contain, remediate, document, and provide notifications where required under applicable law.
Users should promptly contact EveBash if they believe their account or information has been compromised.

EveBash retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it is processed, subject to legal, security, contractual, accounting, fraud-prevention, dispute-resolution, and operational requirements.
Retention periods may vary according to the type of information. For example:
May be retained while the account remains active and for an appropriate period after deletion where necessary.
May be retained while associated events, galleries, subscriptions, or accounts remain active and according to applicable storage and deletion policies.
May be retained for accounting, taxation, fraud prevention, disputes, and other legal obligations.
May be retained for a reasonable period for security monitoring and investigation.
Retained only for the period reasonably necessary to provide the relevant Find You functionality and satisfy applicable legal or security requirements.
Deleted information may remain temporarily in backups, caches, logs, or technical systems until those copies are overwritten or removed according to normal retention cycles.

You can request deletion of your EveBash account and associated personal data. In the mobile app, open Settings and select Delete Account. On the website, sign in and open Settings to find Delete Account. Follow the identity-verification and confirmation steps displayed there.

If you cannot access your account or app, visit https://www.evebash.com/delete-account for a web-accessible request route. Requests may require reasonable verification that you own the account. Account deletion is distinct from signing out, uninstalling the app, or temporarily disabling access.

A deletion request covers the authentication account, profile, and associated personal data, including uploaded content. Records that must be kept for legal obligations, billing disputes, fraud prevention, or security are handled separately. Deletion may take additional time across storage, processors, backups and caches; contact support for the status and applicable retention information.

EveBash plans are bought on our website, not through Apple or Google. If you ever buy a subscription through an app store, deleting your account does not cancel it; manage it through the store that billed you. You can still request account deletion while a subscription is active.
Depending on applicable law and the circumstances of processing, you may have rights relating to your personal information. These may include the ability to:

Requests may be subject to identity verification and applicable legal limitations. India's Digital Personal Data Protection framework provides rights relating to access, correction, erasure and grievance redressal, among other matters, as applicable when the relevant provisions are in force.
Where EveBash relies on consent for a particular processing activity, you may withdraw that consent through the method provided by EveBash.

Withdrawal of consent does not necessarily affect processing that lawfully occurred before withdrawal. Withdrawing consent may make certain features unavailable where the relevant information is necessary to provide those features.

Where required by applicable law, withdrawing consent should be reasonably accessible and comparable in ease to giving consent. India's notified DPDP framework specifically addresses mechanisms for withdrawal and exercising data rights.

EveBash accounts are only for people aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly create accounts for, or accept Find You selfies from, anyone under 18. If you believe someone under 18 has an EveBash account, contact support@evebash.com and we will delete it.

Users may contact EveBash at: support@evebash.com for matters including:

These disclosures apply to EveBash on Android and iOS as well as corresponding website features. Camera access supports taking a selfie for Find You or capturing media where offered. Photo-library access supports selecting uploads and saving media. Files you submit are sent to our services for the gallery or matching feature you choose.

Foreground location access supports nearby business discovery and location-based features. Location may be used to calculate distances or find relevant listings. A business location that you publish on your business profile may be visible to others. To show a readable address, the app may ask your device's built-in location service (Google on Android, Apple on iOS) to convert your coordinates into an address; that provider processes them under its own privacy terms.

When push notifications are enabled, the app registers a device notification token and associates it with your profile. Expo and the relevant Apple or Google notification services process the token and notification payload to deliver notifications. Depending on your settings, notifications may include event invitations, interactions, business updates, or marketing messages. Marketing notifications are off unless you turn them on, and you can turn them off at any time in the app under Settings, Notifications.

You can change camera, photo, location and notification permissions in your device settings. Refusing a permission can limit the feature that needs it. Revoking a device permission does not itself delete information already uploaded; use the deletion and privacy-request procedures above.

The EveBash mobile apps do not currently sell plans or other digital items inside the app. Paid plans are bought on the EveBash website, where Razorpay processes the payment as described in section 10.

If we add purchases through Apple or Google in the future, the store will process the payment under its own privacy terms, EveBash will receive purchase identifiers, receipts or purchase tokens, product information, payment status and subscription status to validate access, address billing issues and prevent fraud, and we will update this policy before that happens.

These Terms apply to the EveBash website and Android and iOS applications. Features, plans and purchase options may differ by platform, app version or region. Only purchase options actually shown in the applicable product are available; references to store purchases do not promise that in-app purchasing is currently offered.

For purchases offered through the Apple App Store or Google Play, the applicable store payment and subscription terms also apply. The purchase screen identifies the price, billing period, renewal conditions and any trial terms before you confirm. Manage a store-billed subscription through that store. Website purchases follow the checkout terms displayed on the website.

Cancellation, refund requests and account deletion are separate processes. The Cancellation & Refund Policy explains the applicable purchase channels. Mandatory consumer rights continue to apply regardless of the purchase channel.

cancellation-refund-policy.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation-refund-policy.description: This Cancellation & Refund Policy explains how cancellations, subscription renewals, plan upgrades, plan downgrades, failed payments, duplicate charges, refund requests, and related billing matters are handled for EveBash Services. This Policy should be read together with the EveBash Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy. Where applicable law provides consumers with additional cancellation, refund, or grievance rights, those rights will continue to apply.

sections.title: Purchase Channel: Website, Apple or Google

blocks.text: This policy applies across the EveBash website, Android app and iOS app. Check your receipt to identify who billed you. The website-payment procedures below apply to purchases made directly from EveBash, including supported Razorpay transactions. They do not replace the procedures of Apple or Google for purchases billed by those stores.

For an Apple-billed purchase, use https://reportaproblem.apple.com to request a refund and https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions to manage or cancel a subscription. Apple handles refund requests under its applicable rules and your statutory rights.

For a Google Play-billed purchase, manage subscriptions at https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions and follow the refund instructions at https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2479637. Responsibility for handling a request depends on Google Play rules, the purchase and applicable law; contact EveBash support if those instructions direct you to the developer.

Uninstalling EveBash or deleting an EveBash account does not itself cancel a store-billed subscription. Cancellation generally stops future renewals; it does not by itself establish entitlement to a refund for the current period. Any refund rights required by law remain available.

If a store-billed option is not offered in your app or region, that purchase channel is unavailable. These provisions do not create a new purchase option or change the billing method of an existing purchase.
Each plan may have different limits relating to:
The applicable price, billing period, plan limits, and included features will be displayed before purchase.
You may cancel or stop renewal of an eligible EveBash paid plan through your account settings where this option is available.
You may also request assistance by contacting: support@evebash.com.
Cancellation generally prevents the next renewal charge.
Unless otherwise stated for a specific plan, cancellation does not automatically terminate the remaining paid subscription period.
For example, if you purchase a monthly plan and cancel halfway through the billing month, you may continue using eligible paid features until the end of that paid billing period.
After the paid period ends, your account may:
move to the applicable free plan;
move to another plan you selected;
lose access to certain paid features; or
become subject to lower storage or usage limits.
Where an EveBash subscription is configured to renew automatically, the subscription will continue for the applicable billing period until cancelled.
Before purchasing an automatically renewing plan, EveBash will display the relevant billing frequency and renewal information.
Where supported by the payment provider, renewal payments may be processed using the payment authorization established when the subscription was created.
Users should cancel before the next scheduled renewal if they do not want the subscription to renew.
Where required by applicable law, EveBash will provide appropriate information or notice relating to recurring billing.
Cancelling a subscription does not necessarily delete:
Instead, cancellation normally affects the plan and features available after the active paid period ends.
Different rules may apply where a user separately requests account deletion. Account deletion is governed by EveBash's Privacy Policy and applicable data-retention rules.
Users may upgrade to a higher EveBash plan where available.
A plan upgrade may provide additional:
Where technically supported, an upgrade may take effect immediately after successful payment confirmation.
EveBash will not rely solely on a frontend payment-success message. The upgrade may be activated only after EveBash receives reliable confirmation from the applicable payment provider.
The amount charged for an upgrade may depend on the billing model used by EveBash.
Depending on the plan, EveBash may:
charge the full price of the new plan;
replace the existing billing period; or
schedule the higher plan for the next billing cycle.
The applicable upgrade price and effective date should be displayed before the user confirms the upgrade. EveBash should not apply an undisclosed upgrade charge.
A downgrade normally moves an account from a higher plan to a lower plan.
Unless otherwise stated, EveBash intends to apply downgrades at the end of the current paid billing period rather than immediately.
This allows users to continue using storage and features they already paid for during the current period.

Example: If a user has a 500 GB plan valid until September 30 and schedules a downgrade to 100 GB on September 10, the 500 GB plan may remain active until September 30 and the 100 GB limit may begin on October 1.
This section is particularly important for EveBash because plans may include different storage limits.
If the amount of media stored in an account exceeds the storage allowance of the downgraded plan, EveBash may:
notify the account holder that storage exceeds the new limit;
allow the user to remove or download eligible media;
allow the user to upgrade again; or
EveBash should not intentionally delete valuable user media immediately merely because a downgrade takes effect, unless a separate policy, notice, or legal requirement clearly provides otherwise.

Where EveBash intends to delete content because an account remains above its storage allowance for an extended period, the user should receive reasonable notice where practicable before deletion. Contact support@evebash.com before downgrading if you need clarification about continued access, exporting media, or the deadline applicable to your account.
If a paid subscription expires or is cancelled and the account becomes eligible for the EveBash free plan, the account will become subject to the storage and feature limits of the free plan.

If existing usage exceeds those limits, certain functionality may be restricted until the user deletes eligible content, reduces usage, renews, upgrades, or otherwise brings the account within applicable limits.
Refund eligibility is determined according to:
whether the service was successfully activated;
Submitting a refund request does not automatically mean the refund will be approved. EveBash will review eligible requests individually.
Unless otherwise stated or required by applicable law, EveBash does not guarantee a full refund solely because a user changes their mind after a paid plan has been activated and substantially used.
This is particularly relevant where EveBash has already provided:
other resources associated with the purchased plan.
However, EveBash may provide a refund, partial refund, credit, or other resolution at its discretion where appropriate and legally permitted.
Cancelling a subscription does not automatically entitle the user to a prorated refund for unused days remaining in the current billing period unless:
the relevant plan provides for prorated refunds;
there was a qualifying technical or billing issue; or
Users will generally continue receiving the paid plan's eligible benefits until the end of the active billing period.
If you believe you were charged more than once for the same purchase, contact: support@evebash.com.
any other information reasonably necessary to locate the transaction.
Do not send full debit/credit card numbers, CVVs, banking passwords, or UPI PINs.
If EveBash confirms that an unintended duplicate payment occurred, the duplicate transaction may be refunded or otherwise corrected.
A failed payment normally does not activate the purchased plan.
Possible reasons for payment failure may include:

If money appears to have been debited but EveBash has not received confirmed payment, users should contact support with the payment reference. In some cases, the payment provider or bank may automatically reverse a failed or incomplete transaction.

sections.title: 15. Payment Successful but Plan Not Activated

blocks.text: If payment succeeds but the EveBash plan does not update correctly, the user should contact: support@evebash.com.
EveBash may verify Razorpay/payment-provider transaction status, signatures, webhooks, orders, and account records.
If successful payment is confirmed, EveBash may activate the correct plan, repair subscription state, apply account credit, or issue a refund.
Some payment methods may remain in a pending state before final confirmation. While a payment remains pending, EveBash may delay activation of the paid plan until confirmed successful.
If payment later fails, the plan will not be activated. If payment succeeds, the plan will be activated.
A refund, account credit, plan extension, or other remedy may be considered where a significant EveBash technical problem prevented the user from receiving the paid service.
payment succeeded but plan could not be activated;
significant paid functionality remained unavailable due to an EveBash issue;
an incorrect plan was charged due to a system error.
Minor interruptions, scheduled maintenance, temporary third-party outages, or issues caused by the user's own device/network do not automatically qualify for a refund.

Where appropriate, EveBash may offer full refunds, partial refunds, account credits, subscription extensions, or plan adjustments based on unavailability duration, affected features, amount paid, and applicable law.
Approved refunds will ordinarily be returned through the original payment method where technically possible.
Users generally cannot request that a refund be sent to an unrelated bank account, UPI ID, card, wallet, or another person's account unless legally required.
After EveBash approves and initiates a refund, processing time depends on payment gateways, banks, card networks, or UPI providers. EveBash does not control third-party processing times.

EveBash may use payment providers such as Razorpay to process payments. Payment providers operate their own infrastructure and terms. A payment provider's role does not remove EveBash's obligations to address legitimate billing complaints.

If a user disputes a payment with their bank or payment provider, EveBash may provide information necessary to respond. Where a payment is reversed or charged back, EveBash may temporarily restrict the paid service while unresolved.
EveBash may refuse refund requests that appear to involve fraud, intentional abuse, repeated misuse of refund processes, or false payment claims, subject to law.
Promotional offers may have specific eligibility, expiration, upgrade, cancellation, or refund rules disclosed before purchase.
EveBash may offer paid add-ons or one-time purchases (extra storage, extra events, premium processing). Refund and cancellation rules for one-time purchases may differ from recurring subscriptions.
Approved refunds may include or exclude applicable taxes depending on tax law, invoice treatment, and gateway rules.

If EveBash terminates a paid account for a serious violation of Terms, refund eligibility depends on the reason, remaining period, and service consumed. Termination for prohibited/fraudulent activity does not guarantee a refund.
If EveBash permanently discontinues a paid service before subscription end, EveBash may provide migration, credit, extension, or refund remedies where required or reasonable.
To request review of a payment or refund issue, contact: support@evebash.com.
Include: registered email, payment/order reference, purchase date, plan, amount, brief explanation, and screenshots. Do not send sensitive credentials.
EveBash reviews refund requests based on gateway status, billing records, account activity, activation, storage/processing usage, and incident logs.
If a billing/refund issue has not been resolved appropriately, submit a grievance to: support@evebash.com under applicable Indian consumer-protection principles.
EveBash may update this Cancellation & Refund Policy as subscription models, payment systems, or legal requirements change. Revisions will update the Last updated date.

digital-service-delivery-policy.title: Digital Service Delivery Policy
digital-service-delivery-policy.description: EveBash provides digital services and does not sell or ship physical products. Therefore, physical shipping, courier delivery, shipping charges, and delivery tracking do not apply to purchases made directly from EveBash.

blocks.text: After successful payment confirmation, eligible subscriptions, storage limits, features, or other digital services are activated electronically on the user's EveBash account.

In most cases, activation occurs shortly after successful payment confirmation. In some circumstances, activation may be delayed because of payment verification, technical processing, security checks, payment-gateway delays, or temporary service issues.
If payment has been successfully completed but the purchased plan or feature is not activated, users may contact support@evebash.com with their payment or order reference for assistance.

EveBash does not require a physical delivery address for delivery of its digital services unless address information is separately required for billing, taxation, identity/business verification, or another lawful purpose.
Questions regarding cancellations or refunds are governed by the EveBash Cancellation & Refund Policy.
For delivery or activation-related assistance, contact support@evebash.com.

The service is delivered digitally on supported EveBash platforms. Availability of individual features can differ between the website, Android and iOS apps. Use the EveBash account associated with your purchase when checking access; do not assume that a second account or a different store account inherits a purchase.

Where Apple or Google purchases are supported, activation depends on confirmation and validation of the store transaction. If your app provides Restore Purchases, use it for an eligible previous purchase. Otherwise contact support with your order reference and the account used for the purchase. Do not send passwords, payment credentials or full card details.

If access is missing after payment, contact support before purchasing the same entitlement again. Refund requests follow the purchase-channel procedures at https://www.evebash.com/cancellation-refund-policy.
